episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/6801_1:
It’s hard to believe Dialga and Palkia have
other forms, huh?

Let’s shine even brighter as the new
Neo Champions!
Yeah! Let’s light hope in everyone’s hearts!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4001_1:
I will be the head judge of this upcoming
Neo Champion Stadium.

What I’m looking for is “the potential of
new bonds”!

Now that new powers like arc suits are
springing up...

I want you all to show me the potential of
a new bond!

Potential on par with the bonds blessed by
Arceus, huh?

Yeah! It’s pretty tough criteria, but that’s all
the more reason to try our best!

Things resembling space-time distortions are
appearing all over Pasio!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4002_1:
Does that mean the space-time distortion is
Cyrus’s doing?!

Maybe, but I don’t see any Team Galactic
around.

If Team Galactic isn’t involved, then he
probably isn’t either.

Yeah... My gut tells me this Palkia must be
different from Cyrus’s.

Either way, if Palkia caused this, then we
have to quell it!

Wh-what’s going on?! Something’s wrong
with the space here!
Dawn! Barry and Rei are gone!

What?! Because of that strange phenomenon
just now?
We need to do something! Let’s go after it!
(but that Palkia looked like it was in pain.)
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4003_1:
We have no clue where Palkia or the
others went.

We tried their Poryphones, but the calls
wouldn’t go through.
Hm... Based on your account...

I fear Barry and Rei may have been sucked
in by Palkia’s powers and transported to
another dimension.
What do we do? I’m worried about them.
Indeed. And what’s more...

I’ve heard there are others who’ve gone
missing because of Palkia.
Seriously?!
I hope everyone is safe.

It’s hard to believe there’s another Palkia
besides Cyrus’s. Is that even possible?
This is only a theory...
but it might have to do with Arceus’s power.
How so?

Like Dialga, Palkia is said to have been
created by Arceus.

And now, with more people awakening
arc suits on Pasio, Arceus’s power must be
growing.

I think it’s safe to assume that power drew
Palkia here.
I see...
That said, we’re still investigating.
But...that Palkia looked like it was in pain.
Hm... If Cynthia’s theory is correct...

Perhaps being forcibly pulled to Pasio
brought out Palkia’s tremendous power,
whether it wanted it to or not.

And now it’s rampaging because it can’t
control that power?
Hm! Indeed.
If that’s the case, I want to help Palkia!
Me too! Let’s start by quelling it!

Professor Rowan and I will search for a way
to recover the missing people.
Dawn, Lucas... We’re counting on you!
You got it!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4004_1:
At Akari’s recommendation, Dawn’s group
sought out Irida of the Pearl Clan, who has
a deep connection to Palkia...
I can’t believe Irida’s gone missing, too.
Yeah. We searched everywhere.
Not even my clairvoyance could find her.

But Irida was supposed to be the one who’d
know how to quell Palkia.

Hey, Lucas. Couldn’t you use mighty Dialga’s
power to calm down mighty Palkia?

Palkia’s power in this other form was
incredible.

I’m not sure even Dialga could stand
up to it.
Oh! That’s nothing to worry about!
Huh?

The power you saw was likely that of
mighty Palkia’s true form.

But mighty Dialga, its counterpart, has a true
form of its own!
Really?!
You bet!

Think about it, Lucas. Mighty Dialga
accepted you.

I’m sure it’ll respond to your desire to help
its companion!
All right! I’ll do my best!
I’m starting to have hope again!
Yes!

We also want to help quell Palkia—however
we can. Let’s do some training!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4005_1:
Akari was smart to choose me as your
training partner!
And thanks for callin’ us here, too!

Team MZ’ll do what we can to help
everyone on Pasio!

We’re pretty confident when it comes to
battling rogue Pokémon!

By the way, what training do you have
in mind?

To quell this rogue Palkia, you’ll need to
dodge its attacks!

That’s right! As practice, you’re going to
dodge Pecharunt’s attacks over and over
and OVER!
Don’t sweat it! We’ll be right here with you!
We’ll teach you how to dodge. I promise!

Apparently, Harmony and Urbain can dodge
just as well as Rei!

Yeah! We’ll teach you the same as we
would any member of Team MZ!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4006_1:
After their training, Dawn and Lucas’s group
searched all over Pasio and finally found
Palkia...
Palkia... It looks like it’s in a lot of pain!
That’s why we need to quell it!
Dialga!
Lend me your strength! To save everyone!
Dialga is...shining?!

Is this Dialga’s other form, just like Adaman
said?!

This is great! It responded to your feelings,
Lucas!
All right, Dialga! Let’s quell Palkia!

It’s a clash between the controllers of time
and space!

The shock waves from their battle reach all
the way over here!

But if I want to quell Palkia, I need to get
closer!

Relax, Dawn... You can do it—for Lucas and
the others!

Remember the dodges Akari’s group
taught you!
Palkia! Please calm down!
I know you don’t want to do this!
Urk!

Palkia, no! Please stop hurting them...and
yourself!
Huh?!
Dawn! Now!
Palkia!
I know you’re hurting too...

But if you keep going, you’ll do something
you can never take back!

Palkia! I want to help everyone... I want
to help YOU!
So please!
Wha—?!
Palkia...?
I did it!
Nice work, Dawn!
It’s all thanks to you and Dialga, Lucas!

Now all that’s left is to save the missing
people!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4007_1:
You two! We figured out how to recover
those who disappeared!

Since Palkia’s powers are what sent them to
another dimension...

we should be able to use those same
powers to get them back!
If that’s the case, then we’re on it!
Dialga and I will help too!

We should be able to use Dialga’s time
control to come right back to this time
and place!

As long as Dawn and I work together with
Dialga and Palkia, we can do this!
Please rescue Rei and the others!
If things get dicey, Team MZ’ll help you!
Be sure to come back, you two.
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4008_1: Hey! What’s that light over there?!
It’s mighty Palkia! And Dawn and Lucas!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4009_1:
All the people who disappeared have made
it back safely!

Palkia has been quelled, and Pasio’s peace
has been restored! We’re safe now!

And for that, we have these exceptional
Trainers to thank. Let’s give a big round
of applause for Dawn and Lucas!

Lucas caused Dialga to assume its true form
to calm the rampaging Palkia!

And Dawn forged a bond with Palkia,
forming a sync pair with it and returning
everyone to Pasio!

You both drew upon the strength of deities,
and in doing so, showed me the potential of
new bonds!
You are the Neo Champions I envisioned!

Now! Show us all the power of Dialga and
Palkia in their true forms!

I’ve been wanting to test out Dialga’s new
strength!

Same here! I want to see Palkia’s hidden
potential!
episode_event_ch0116_90_ch0162_90/4010_1:
That was spectacular! So the deities who
control time and space... That’s their power
and true forms!

I’m so happy we get to be Neo Champions
together, Lucas!
So am I! You’re the best rival ever, Dawn!
It certainly is a thrill being with you two!
Please continue to show us new things!
Will do! I want to learn more about Palkia!

And of course, I’ll still help out as your
research assistant, Professor!

Now then—as Neo Champions, please say
a few words for everyone watching!

A brilliant view awaits you, no matter how
long it takes to reach!

The miracles Trainers and Pokémon make
together can cross any space, no matter
the distance!
Believe in the potential of our new bonds!

From here on out, we’ll keep shining as
Neo Champions!
